finding: Hypothesis H34 independent audit reveals: 1. Candidate C4 Direct (Package 115) and Candidate C4 Sequential Continuation (Package 113) are fundamentally NON-COMPARABLE physical reference states. Package 113 is an incremental forward continuation (Frames 77->78->79) with 1,640 clamped nodes, while Package 115 is a static direct transfer at Frame 79 with only 110 clamped nodes. 2. Between Sequential and Direct C4 states, the total energy difference is -46.27 nJ (-0.0213%), which exceeds H33's 20.58 nJ fine-mesh truncation estimate by 2.25x. 3. More critically, an elastic-fracture energy compensation of 1.504 uJ (98.4% cancellation) masks a major disparity in physical state: Package 113 has +1.458 uJ (+0.85%) higher elastic energy and -1.504 uJ (-3.30%) lower fracture energy, accompanied by a -4.69% lower peak damage (0.4992 vs 0.5238) and +1.603 N (+0.86%) stiffer reaction force. 4. Therefore, while H33 correctly identified that coarse C3 under-resolves AT2 fracture gradients (+11.1% shift in direct transfer), H33's conclusion that Package 113's sequential continuation is consistent within truncation error is REFUTED. Scalar total-energy uncertainty overlap alone does NOT establish physical transfer correctness. Consequently, transfer error is NOT excluded (H34_TRANSFER_ERROR_NOT_EXCLUDED). In accordance with governance rules, submission of an artificial HPC job is WITHHELD. The governing gate STAGE_C1_2_STEP2_ENERGY_GATE_FAILED and classification P113_GATE_VALID_FAILURE remain strictly retained.
